| # Wake up {#wake-up-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}                                                                                   |                                                                                                                                                    |
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

Wakeup in terms of system (ECU) refers to transition of ECU system state from OFF state, to make the ECU up and running.

For transition in system states please refer the page [System State Machine](system-state-machine.html){.topiclink}.

Wakeup happens in RC4x series ECUs with the help of the following methods:

 

- Wakeup by T15 - It refers to wakeup of ECU by turning T15 (Ignition Pin) On.

- [Wakeup by CAN](wakeup-by-can.html){.topiclink}
